about.text1: Hey!, I'm Ignacio Fonseca, a Fullstack Developer in training. I currently work with Next.js and React, and on my own I'm learning ASP.NET to strengthen my backend skills.
about.text2: I am most passionate about server-side programming and algorithms.
about.text3: I have developed several personal projects, including web applications and small video games, which have allowed me to apply my knowledge of React, databases, and programming logic in real-world environments.
about.text4: Outside the world of code, I enjoy both video games and board games as well as creating my own video games using GameMaker Studio 1.4, combining creativity and logic in fun and challenging projects.
about.text5: I am always looking to learn new technologies, experiment with innovative projects, and improve my skills by solving programming and algorithm challenges.

project1.name: Mundo Matriz (Matrix World)
project1.description: It is a console program for matrix calculations; it was one of my first approaches to C++.

project2.name: EncryptFons
project2.description: It is a console program where I was experimenting with the use of pointers and memory access.

project3.name: Run
project3.description: It is a game I created while experimenting with the 3D features of GameMaker: Studio 1.4.

project4.name: Eagle Killer
project4.description: It is a Wolfenstein 3D clone that I made in GameMaker: Studio 1.4 to experiment with raycasting. Initially, it started as a game for the Global Game Jam 2021, but I continued its development afterward.

project5.name: core
project5.description: It is a basic and simple shooter experimenting with seed generation and the use of pseudo-random numbers.

project6.name: Stockify
project6.description: A simple inventory system for eCommerce where products can be created, updated, and deleted, as well as managing supplier contact information to track the origin of the products.

project7.name: DigitalArs Wallet
project7.description: It is a digital wallet that my team and I developed as the final project for the Alkemy .NET/React course.

project8.name: gestion proyectos vuedjango (project management)
project8.description: This is a system where you can efficiently manage your projects. You can create, view, update, and delete projects, tasks, and team members. Comments can also be added to help track the progress of each project.

project9.name: LocalBox
project9.description: It is a storage system that allows you to create and manage your own NAS server. You can upload, delete, and download files, manage multiple users, and share files within the network, either with specific users or with all registered users.

aboutPortafolio.text1: This portfolio is built with ReactJS, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS 4.
aboutPortafolio.text2: My goal with this project is to showcase my work style and my frontend development skills by creating modern, functional, and optimized interfaces.
aboutPortafolio.text3: Through this portfolio, I aim to reflect not only my technical knowledge but also my passion for programming, my attention to detail, and my commitment to writing clean and scalable code, applying best practices at every stage of development.
aboutPortafolio.text4: It also represents my continuous learning process and my motivation to grow as a professional, exploring new technologies and challenging myself with each project.
